summary_en: Keep it whole and wrap it. Give it to staff or a collection point.
prep_en: Keep it whole :: Do not break it.|Wrap it :: Use paper or its original box.|Hand it over :: Give it to staff or a hazardous waste collection point.
note_en: Fluorescent bulbs contain mercury. Do not break them.
hazard_en: Fluorescent tubes and CFLs contain mercury. A broken lamp releases mercury vapour.
fact_en: Fluorescent bulbs contain mercury, which is toxic when released.
